name: Wayward Samaritan
source:
After failing to credit your bullies on a college assignment, they jump you and beat you relentlessly. Just when all hope seems lost, an unlikely savior comes to your rescue. 

But is he the good Samaritan he appears to be, or is there something sinister lurking behind his charismatic façade?

[From [url=https://cursorist.itch.io/wayward-samaritan]Itch.io[/url]]
